title: Over to scratch
story: Big files don't belong in your home folder. Your labmate copied a dataset to /scratch/student/{{dataset}}. Go there using its full path, then count how many PDB files it holds.

files./scratch/student/{{dataset}}/MANIFEST.tx: Structures for the next design round.

tasks.text: Report how many .pdb files are there: answer and the number

hints: A path that starts with `/` is absolute: it works from anywhere.
